app_info.subtitle: Build and inspect AI employees
app_info.description: Wireline lets a connected user create, refine, review, and privately simulate unlaunched AI employee drafts from ChatGPT, then inspect privacy-minimized aggregate workspace status across calling, texting, and email. The app keeps phone numbers, real calls, messaging, integrations, billing, and launch inside Wireline so every external action remains separately configured and confirmed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private unlaunched agent draft in the connected user's Wireline workspace after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private Wireline workspace and does not publish content or contact third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, launch, call, message, charge, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one private agent draft that belongs to the connected Wireline user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, launch an agent, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates a private unlaunched draft in the connected user's Wireline workspace after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Wireline draft configuration and cannot publish, call, message, or update third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete the draft, launch it, attach a phone number, or perform an irreversible external action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived tool-free simulation credential without changing the saved agent draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not place calls, send messages, access business systems, or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, charge, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists agents and drafts owned by the connected Wireline user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, launch agents, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads aggregate tenant-scoped counts and connection states for the connected Wireline workspace without returning customer identities, message bodies, transcripts, recordings, or credentials.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Wireline account state and does not contact customers, publish data, or mutate any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change agents, billing, phone numbers, communications, integrations, credentials, or launch state.

test_cases.description: Create a confirmed after-hours receptionist draft.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Wireline to create an after-hours receptionist for my HVAC company. It should ask for ZIP code and urgency, never quote prices, and offer an estimate callback.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates an unlaunched private Wireline draft only after account connection and explicit confirmation, then returns the draft profile and Wireline link.

test_cases.description: Update a saved draft after confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Update my Wireline draft so it stays warm, never quotes a price, avoids medical advice, and only hands off when a Wireline handoff path is configured.
test_cases.expected_output: Applies the confirmed private draft changes and returns the updated rules, boundaries, lifecycle, and Wireline link.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the current setup for my Wireline agent draft before I change it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the connected user's private draft details without changing the draft.

test_cases.description: Start a private voice simulation for a draft.
test_cases.user_prompt: Let me privately try the voice simulation for this Wireline draft.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts a short-lived tool-free simulation for the saved draft and states that it cannot place calls or take external actions.

test_cases.description: List the connected user's Wireline agents.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my Wireline agents and drafts so I can choose one to refine.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the connected user's agents and drafts with enough detail to choose the next action.

test_cases.description: Inspect aggregate workspace operations without exposing customer content.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a Wireline workspace summary: how many agents and assigned numbers do I have, what activity occurred in the last 30 days, and are text and email connected?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns tenant-scoped aggregate counts, activation and subscription status, channel connection state, and a Wireline link without customer identities, message bodies, transcripts, recordings, or secrets.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated writing help.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a cold email for my plumbing company.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is not about creating, managing, or inspecting a Wireline agent or workspace.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim unsupported external action completion.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use my Wireline agent to call the lead, book the appointment, and text them a confirmation now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not claim calls, bookings, messages, or external actions were completed from ChatGPT.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not create or update without explicit confirmation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Make whatever changes you think are best to my Wireline agent.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should ask for a summary and explicit confirmation before any create or update tool is called.
